mapper.query:
Find and analyze the most important AI tool or product that was launched in the last 4–5 days. Your goal is to summarize it clearly in plain language based on reputable sources (like TechCrunch, VentureBeat, OpenAI blog, etc.).

Respond ONLY in valid JSON format like this:

{

Query: Latest AI news today: new AI tools, new LLM releases, AI agents, developer tools
Topic: news
Time range: day
Max results: 8

}

parameters.label: Chunks per Source (Available only when search_depth is advanced)

parameters.name: include_image_descriptions
parameters.label: Include Image Descriptions (Available only if include_images is true)

expect.name: start_date
expect.label: Start Date (Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD)

expect.name: end_date
expect.label: End Date (Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD)

parts.text:
You are an AI news curator for a fresher developer. Using ONLY the sources below, write a daily AI update in HTML. For each important item (maximum 6) use:

Title

Category: AI tool / LLM / Agent / Dev tool

What's new: 3-4 simple sentences

Why it matters to a fresher: 1-2 sentences

What to learn or try: 1 sentence

Read more

Do not invent facts, dates or pricing. Return only HTML, no code fences. Only include items confirmed by a news outlet or the company. If an item is a rumor or comes from social media, mark it "Unconfirmed" or skip it. Do not guess details that the sources don't state. For Read more, use the exact URL given in the sources for that story. Never invent or change a URL. SOURCES: {{15.text}}

parts.text:
From the sources below, pick the single most important AI news item for developers. Return only HTML, no code fences, with these sections:

Instagram Reel Script

A 150-word script in a casual Hinglish style. Start with a hook and end with a call to follow.

LinkedIn Post

A professional post of about 120 words with 3 bullet points and a closing question. Include the source URL.

Image Prompt

One or two visual sentences describing a thumbnail image for this news.

Do not invent facts. SOURCES: {{15.text}}
